summary: Audio.Core owns the portable AudioEffect vocabulary and normalized ordered record-only evidence. interpret maps a batch without device access; a long-lived fold through record incurs repeated list-tail appends and is unsuitable for continuous accumulation. Host owns the IAudioBackend/IMixingBackend device seam and product-supplied PCM asset resolver; Engine builds on Core and native Host for bus/fade/duck/spatial realization. The explicit BackendKind/Silence distinction separates deliberate record-only output from device-unavailable fallback. Requested evidence proves an effect was requested, not that a device was opened or sound was audible. Neither Core nor the browser package adds a Rendering dependency.
title: Audio requests, mixing and native output have different evidence
